title: 32 km inversion, 30 L-BFGS-B iterations under scpc_gamg (bt line search)
mesh: antarctica_320000_32000_buffered0 (Quartz's .msh, sha256 fd66fc42; 6,282 vertices, 9,055 cells), DG0 geometry, vertex raster sampling
initial_state: cold start: u = 0.1 u_obs, theta = phi = 0, the n,m 1 to 3 ramp, then ISMIP7_EVAL_CONTINUATION=0 (one annotated solve at full n an evaluation)
forcing: MEaSUREs v2 450 m (sha256 268be94e) and BedMachine v4.1 (sha256 6bd08dbb), byte-identical to Quartz's antarctica/data; ISMIP7_FLUIDITY_PRIOR=legacy; no dH/dt term
site: IU workstation (Mac, 16 cores, 128 GB), data under /Volumes/LaCie/Data/antarctica_general/ismip7_obs
resources: 8 ranks, run beside the full_mumps twin; peak 2.1 GB a rank
cost: 438 s for 30 iterations (32 evaluations): 9.5 s forward and 0.6 s adjoint an evaluation, 5.1 Newton iterations and 51 V-cycles a condensed solve
audit: the same 30 iterations and 32 evaluations as test-32km-inversion-lbfgs-full-mumps; every evaluation's objective within 4.3e-7 of it and |grad| within 1e-4; published residual 1.20e-3; no forward failed; every recorded solve confirmed the paused solve's state with no step
